lines.zh: 挥舞着双翅，悄无声息地飘来。
lines.en: Wings flutter silently as it glides by.

lines.zh: 避开你的目光，继续前行。
lines.en: Eyes avoiding yours, it continues walking.

lines.zh: 双翅轻盈地拍打，飘向远方。
lines.en: Wings beat lightly, floating away.

lines.zh: 光点拖在身后，像条细线。
lines.en: Light points trail behind me like a thread.

lines.zh: 缓缓扇动翅膀，悄无声息。
lines.en: Slowly flaps its wings, silently.

lines.zh: 在空中快速滑翔，消失不见。
lines.en: Rapidly glides through the air, out of sight.
Wings as deep as the night sky.

lines.zh: 轻轻拍打翅膀，融入黑暗。
lines.en: Gently flaps its wings, blending into the darkness.

lines.zh: 双翅闪烁，如星辰般璀璨。
lines.en: Wings shimmer, like stars.
Flies slowly, leaving no trace.
My wings scatter flecks of light.

lines.zh: 我乘着天境的风滑过去。
lines.en: I ride the Aether's wind and glide past.
Stops in mid-air, quietly observing.
Perches in the air, waiting for its chance.
Wings half-open, waiting for prey.
Pauses, blending into the darkness.
Silently perches, waiting for prey.
Pauses in mid-air, wings half-open.
Silently stands, wings motionless.
Perches briefly, quietly observing.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的光，一闪一闪。
lines.en: The light on my wings flickers and fades.
Pauses in mid-air, wings still.

lines.zh: 我落在浮空石上收起翅膀。
lines.en: I settle on a floating stone and fold my wings.
The light on my wings flickers bright and dim.
Hovering still, I listen to the wind.

lines.zh: 光尘绕着我的翅尖打转。
lines.en: Motes of light circle my wingtips.
Suddenly turns, staring at the player.
Eyes flicker, fixating on the player.
Stares intently at the player.

lines.zh: 注意到了玩家，缓缓接近。
lines.en: Notices the player, slowly approaching.
Stares at the player, wings barely moving.
Locks eyes, slowly closing the distance.
Stares at the player, wings half-open.
Staring at the player, wings still.

lines.zh: 我翅上的光，映在你瞳里。
lines.en: The light on my wings sits in your pupils.
Stares at the player, eyes glowing.
My compound eyes hold your reflection.

lines.zh: 我贴着你肩头转了半圈。
lines.en: I skim half a circle around your shoulder.
I turn my winglight onto your face.
I hover at your shoulder and size you up.
My antennae reach toward you.

lines.zh: 一点光落进你的眼睛里。
lines.en: A fleck of light lands in your eye.
You are surrounded by a shimmer.

lines.zh: 我的视线跟着你转整圈。
lines.en: My gaze follows you all the way around.
My wing membrane split; light leaks out.
Wings broken...
So much pain...

lines.zh: 我的翅膀亮了一下，然后灭了。
lines.en: My wings flickered once, then went dim.
Come quick!
Stay away from me!
Membrane torn, my light is leaking out.
So scared...
Half my wing dust rubbed off.
The light on my wings dims...

lines.zh: 它那透明的翅膀闪烁着微光，诱惑着你走近。
lines.en: Its gossamer wings shimmer, tempting you closer.

lines.zh: 它轻轻扇动翅膀，仿佛在与你共舞。
lines.en: It flutters its wings, as if dancing with you.

lines.zh: 它在月光下显得更为妖艳，难以抗拒。
lines.en: In the moonlight, it appears even more alluring.

lines.zh: 它那柔软的触须轻轻触碰你的指尖。
lines.en: Its soft antennae gently touch your fingertips.

lines.zh: 它在你耳边低语，似乎有话要说。
lines.en: It whispers in your ear, as if to say something.

lines.zh: 它的声音如同夜风，轻柔而诱人。
lines.en: Its voice is like a night breeze, soft and tempting.

lines.zh: 它的眼中似乎有着不为人知的秘密。
lines.en: Its eyes seem to hold secrets not meant for humans.

lines.zh: 它的每一扇动都带起一阵凉意。
lines.en: Each flutter brings a chill.

lines.zh: 亮一点的地方，我就靠近。
lines.en: Where it is brighter, I drift closer.

lines.zh: 你身上有我喜欢的微光。
lines.en: You carry a glimmer I like.

lines.zh: 你被它透明的翅膀擦伤了皮肤。
lines.en: You are scratched by its gossamer wings.

lines.zh: 它透明的翅膀在空中划出一道闪光。
lines.en: Its wings flash in the air.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀几乎透明，几乎看不到。
lines.en: Its wings are nearly transparent.

lines.zh: 它突然撞向你，翅膀发出细微的声音。
lines.en: It collides with you, making a faint sound.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在空中摩擦，发出沙沙声。
lines.en: Its wings rustle in the air.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在空中轻拂，带起一阵凉意。
lines.en: Its wings brush by, bringing a chill.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在你的脸上拂过，冰凉的触感。
lines.en: Its wings brush your face, cool to the touch.

lines.zh: 它在你身边飞行，翅膀轻轻掠过。
lines.en: It flies by, its wings lightly brushing.

lines.zh: 它的透明翅膀在光线下显得更加清晰。
lines.en: Its transparent wings appear clearer in the light.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在空中摩擦，发出细微的响声。
lines.en: Its wings rub together, making a faint noise.

lines.zh: 它在月光下寻找伴侣，发出细微的声音。
lines.en: It searches for a mate in the moonlight, making a faint sound.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀闪给另一只蝶看。
lines.en: My wings flicker for another butterfly.

lines.zh: 它在月光下与同类翩翩起舞。
lines.en: It dances with its kind in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它发出细微的叫声，寻找配偶。
lines.en: It makes a faint call, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它在空中与其他同类交织飞翔。
lines.en: It weaves through the air with other of its kind.

lines.zh: 它在月光下轻盈地飞舞，寻找配偶。
lines.en: It dances lightly in the moonlight, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它发出微弱的叫声，召唤配偶。
lines.en: It makes a weak call, summoning a mate.

lines.zh: 它在空中与其他同类交错飞翔。
lines.en: It weaves with other of its kind in the air.

lines.zh: 它在月光下轻盈地飞舞，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: It dances lightly in the moonlight, searching for a partner.

lines.zh: 它在空中与其他同类交织飞行。
lines.en: It weaves through the air with other of its kind.
Touch its skin, feel the chill.
Wings shine like night明珠.
Drinks dew, like a ghost.
Dances in the night.
Wings flap, cold wind rises.
Whispers when approaching.
A flicker in the dark.
Touch and vanish, ghostly.
Phantom in the darkness.
Uncertain, unsettling.
Target acquired, chill increases.
Eyes lock, like a pit.
Eyes like torches, source of terror.
Chill through the gaze.
Gaze like frost.
Chill spreads through gaze.
Gaze like a blade.
Fear rises with gaze.
Gaze like lightning.
Chilly wind with gaze.
My winglight turns and settles on you.
The light has chosen you.
The motes gather into a beam aimed at you.
I tighten my circles around you.
Scale dust scatters around you.
Only your outline is left in my sight.
Fear when approaching.
Chill approaches.
Chilly wind with gaze.
Chill increases with approach.
Chill with gaze.
Chill on approach, escape impossible.
Cold on approach, icy.
Chill with approach.
Chill on approach.
Cold on approach.
My wings beat faster and my light grows brighter.
I circle close to your ear.

lines.zh: 光尘正在吸走你的温度。
lines.en: The dust is drawing the warmth out of you.
Round and round, I close you in.

lines.zh: 翅尖几乎碰到你的脖子。
lines.en: My wingtip nearly brushes your neck.

lines.zh: 寒意顺着光爬到你身上。
lines.en: The chill climbs up the light onto you.

lines.zh: 我把光收进翅里，准备扑。
lines.en: I draw the light into my wings and ready to dive.
Do not blink; I close in with the dark.

lines.zh: 它张开巨大的翅膀向你扑来！
lines.en: It lunges at you with massive wings.

lines.zh: 它的触角试图触碰你的皮肤！
lines.en: Its antennae try to touch your skin.

lines.zh: 它尖锐的爪子划过你的身体！
lines.en: Its sharp claws scratch your body.

lines.zh: 它的触须发出嘶嘶声，向你逼近！
lines.en: Its feelers hiss and inch closer.

lines.zh: 眼中的光一沉，我撞过去。
lines.en: The light in my eyes sinks; I strike.

lines.zh: 它的触角触碰你的脸，令人恶心！
lines.en: Its antennae touch your face, grossing you out.

lines.zh: 它用触手缠绕你的四肢！
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around your limbs.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀拍打着你的身躯！
lines.en: Its wings smack your body.

lines.zh: 它在你耳边低语，令人恐惧！
lines.en: It whispers in your ear, terrifying you.

lines.zh: 它的触须缠绕住你的脖子！
lines.en: Its feelers wrap around your neck.
A burst of light hits your face!
My wing edge slashes your hand!
Scale dust blinds your eyes!
I dart straight at your throat!

lines.zh: 一点冷光刺进你的皮肤！
lines.en: A needle of cold light pricks your skin!
My wingbeat knocks you back a step!

lines.zh: 夜幕降临，天境蝴蝶出现！
lines.en: The sky butterflies emerge at dusk.

lines.zh: 它们在黑暗中寻找猎物！
lines.en: They hunt in the dark.

lines.zh: 它们隐藏在阴影里，静待机会！
lines.en: They hide in shadows, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 你突然被一个幽灵般的身影包围！
lines.en: You are suddenly surrounded by ghostly figures.

lines.zh: 天境蝴蝶成群结队出现！
lines.en: The sky butterflies swarm.

lines.zh: 它们似乎对光有特别的反应！
lines.en: They seem to react to light.

lines.zh: 一群天境蝴蝶飞入你的领地！
lines.en: A group of sky butterflies fly into your territory.

lines.zh: 它们在空中盘旋，寻找目标！
lines.en: They circle in the air, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 夜晚，天境蝴蝶开始活动！
lines.en: At night, the sky butterflies start moving.

lines.zh: 它们喜欢在树林中出没！
lines.en: They like to venture into the forests.

lines.zh: 天境的黄昏里，我们亮起。
lines.en: In the Aether's dusk, we light up.

lines.zh: 从浮空岛的花丛飞出来。
lines.en: We rise from the flowers of the floating isle.
The lights arrive before I do.
A cluster of glimmer settles on the stone.

lines.zh: 风把我从云层里带下来。
lines.en: The wind carries me down out of the clouds.

lines.zh: 我在花蜜的香气里现身。
lines.en: I appear where the nectar smells sweetest.
At night our winglights bloom in patches.

lines.zh: 我们顺着那道光线飞进来。
lines.en: We follow a thread of light in.
Fire...so hot...
Fell down...
Drowned in water...
Explosion...so painful...
Arrow...hit me...
Magic...so painful...
No nectar left, and my light dims.
Lightning...so painful...
Void...so cold...
